The dedicated IP page read today lists no port forwarding among the benefits of a dedicated IP, and describes buying or requesting one.

notes: (2) both statements are true of different things, since the 2025 sentence explicitly says router port forwarding, and a VPN-side forward would be a different feature, which the same page then contradicts in its next sentence by saying FastestVPN does not allow it; (3) the press report described a beta that never reached general availability.
